change.summary: Make the JEM Halloween atmosphere an automatic annual client-local season owned by JEM Holidays.

modifiers.before: Halloween presentation requires a manually selected resource pack.
modifiers.after: The local client enables Halloween from October 30 through November 2 inclusive and returns to normal on November 3 every year.

modifiers.before: The Jalloween pack has no calendar owner.
modifiers.after: JEM Holidays ensures JEM Release is active as the base, places Jalloween above it and places the separately installed Halloween GUI above Jalloween. On November 3 it removes seasonal additions, restores previously selected seasonal packs near their saved neighbors and preserves JEM Release plus unrelated changes.

modifiers.before: Minecraft menu and world music remain native.
modifiers.after: JEM Holidays owns the approved AudioYT menu and world playlists during the seasonal window, suppresses only ordinary background music and yields audibly to records without interrupting them.

modifiers.before: Seasonal mobs have no JEM-owned head decoration.
modifiers.after: Humanoid-rendered mobs receive a proportional full-bright vanilla jack-o-lantern during October 30 through November 2. Players, creepers and other non-humanoid mobs are excluded.

rationale.purpose: Apply the same reversible annual Halloween presentation in the main menu, singleplayer and multiplayer without server authority or world-data mutation.
rationale.decision_source: User schedule and JEM Holidays architecture request on 2026-10-30

introduced.summary: Add the standalone annual Halloween presentation owner.

history.summary: Add the standalone annual Halloween presentation owner.
Correct seasonal pack precedence and restoration, enable the installed Halloween GUI above Jalloween, and disable unreliable AudioYT streaming.
Render proportional full-bright vanilla jack-o-lanterns on the requested humanoid seasonal mobs while excluding players, creepers and other non-humanoid mobs.

Ensure every AutoModpack client activates JEM Release below JEM Jalloween during the seasonal window so the approved base presentation and Quick Skin placement are available without manual pack selection.

notes: The seasonal controller is client-only and uses the operating-system local date and timezone.
During Halloween the selected-pack order keeps JEM Release below JEM Jalloween, matching the user-approved test jem stack.
No biome, world, server or gameplay state is modified.
The YouTube recordings are not bundled or downloaded by JEM Holidays.
The mob decoration reuses the vanilla jack-o-lantern model and changes no item, equipment, light-level or server-authority state.
unresolved: The corrected calendar, resource-pack transition, AudioYT coexistence and proportional mob placement remain pending player acceptance because Codex did not launch the client.
